recurring_ai_for_public_good_editions.conclusion: Lot 1 (Health: cancer imaging) of the first 'AI for Public Good' edition (EC-CNECT/2024/OP/0094) received 11 electronic submissions but closed without a winner ('clos-nw', non-award-justification 'other'). The second edition (EC-CNECT/2026/OP/0003), with an identical estimated budget, re-ran the same lot and awarded it. Lot 2 (Energy) was awarded in the second edition; the first edition's Lot 2 result (763846-2025) could not be retrieved (HTTP 202 on every attempt, see adversarial.md) and is not claimed.
